issue.S: Michael can sign in to his workstation and access the internet, but he receives an Access Denied error when opening the Accounting shared folder on FILESERVER01. Other Accounting employees can access the share normally.

objective.S: Investigate the user's identity, group membership, connectivity, and file share access. Identify the root cause and recommend a fix.

expectedDiagnosis.S: The user's account is missing the Accounting-Share security group membership required to access the Accounting file share.

expectedSolution.S: Add the user to the Accounting-Share security group and refresh the user's security token by signing out and back in before testing the share again.
